name: Birmingham Airport
title: Birmingham Airport guide: terminals, airlines and getting there
intro: Birmingham has one terminal, next to the NEC and Birmingham International station. Here's who flies from it and how to get there.

terminals.name: The terminal
terminals.airlines: Jet2, TUI, Ryanair, Emirates and others
terminals.text: One terminal with one security area, so you can't go to the wrong one.

sections.heading: Getting to Birmingham Airport
sections.text:
- **Train:** Birmingham International station is on the main line, about 10 minutes from Birmingham New Street and with direct trains from London Euston. The free Air-Rail Link shuttle takes you from the station to the terminal in a couple of minutes.
- **Car:** the airport is off junction 6 of the M42. There's a charge for the drop-off area outside the terminal.

faqs.question: How many terminals does Birmingham Airport have?
Is there a train station at Birmingham Airport?
faqs.answer: Yes, Birmingham International, linked to the terminal by the free Air-Rail Link shuttle.
